findings: [P2] web/src/main.jsx: The start dialog does not freeze the Issue fingerprint when opened. SSE refreshes can replace detail while the dialog remains open, and start() submits the new detail.fingerprint. If another owner screen changes the requirements after this owner opens the dialog, confirmation silently starts work against requirements this owner did not review. Capture project_id, issue_id, and expected fingerprint in the start modal, submit those captured values, and require reopening after STALE_REQUIREMENTS. Add a delayed-refresh browser test equivalent to the existing stale-edit test.
requirements_checked: Reviewed supplied source only, without tools; supplied test results were not independently verified.
Checked pairing possession, single use, session expiry/logout, cookie settings, exact Host/Origin checks, and CSRF enforcement. Actor names and AI verdicts were not treated as authentication.
Checked request body bounds/deadlines, routing, fixed launch arguments, process registration, cancellation/resume, SSE cursors, and React asynchronous state handling.
Checked artifact integrity, approval expiry/replay protection, current requirement binding, and receipt verification by ContextBuilder.
The two supplied prior findings are addressed: local text follows '--', and approval previews expose Issue descriptions and verified formal decisions.
Excluded simultaneous external Beads writes and Phase 7 operational requirements as specified.
